scenarios.name: Geopolitical Escalation in Middle East
scenarios.description: A flashpoint conflict disrupts energy supply chains and redirects defense spending, impacting trade routes and energy prices.

impacts.explanation: Reduced consumer and business confidence due to energy volatility.
Increased import costs for energy and strategic goods.
Market uncertainty drives investors to safer assets.

scenarios.reasoning: Middle Eastern conflicts historically correlate with economic volatility. Base rates from past oil crises suggest moderate impact.
tetlockCommandments: Break seemingly intractable problems into tractable sub-problems

scenarios.name: US-China Trade War Escalation
scenarios.description: New tariffs and supply chain reconfiguration disrupt manufacturing and export sectors.

impacts.explanation: Higher production costs for exported goods.
Increased trade barriers reduce export competitiveness.
Automation adoption slows due to uncertainty.

scenarios.reasoning: Trade tensions have repeatedly reduced GDP growth by 0.5-1.2% in historical data. Current tariff trends suggest persistent effects.
tetlockCommandments: Look for the errors behind your errors

scenarios.name: Fed Rate Hike Cycle
scenarios.description: The Federal Reserve raises rates to Combat inflation, increasing borrowing costs.

impacts.explanation: Long-term yields rise with rate hikes.
Higher mortgage rates dampen housing demand.

scenarios.reasoning: Historical Fed rate hikes have slowed GDP growth by 0.5% annually. Current inflationary trends (3.46 CPI) justify action.
tetlockCommandments: Strike the right balance between under- and overreacting to evidence

scenarios.name: Global Supply Chain Stabilization
scenarios.description: Resolution of geopolitical tensions and container shipping cost reductions boost trade.
scenarios.reasoning: Post-pandemic supply chain investments and reduced geopolitical risks align with this scenario.

scenarios.name: Domestic Housing Market Correction
scenarios.description: Higher mortgage rates and supply chain delays reduce housing starts growth.

impacts.explanation: Lower consumer spending on home-related goods.

scenarios.reasoning: Rising rates and labor shortages historically reduce housing starts by 2-4% quarterly.
tetlockCommandments: Triage - Focus on questions where careful thinking pays off

scenarios.name: Labor Market Stagnation
scenarios.description: Limited job growth despite low unemployment due to automation and sector shifts.

impacts.explanation: Sectoral shifts reduce hiring in traditional industries.
Lower consumer spending due to job insecurity.

scenarios.reasoning: Structural labor market changes often decouple unemployment and GDP growth. Tech sector trends support this.
tetlockCommandments: Bring out the best in others

methodology: Scenarios were constructed using probabilistic thinking and historical economic precedents. Weighted forecasts aggregate scenario impacts weighted by likelihood. Confidence reflects uncertainty in scenario probabilities and magnitude estimates.
geopoliticalSummary: Potential conflicts in the Middle East and Eastern Europe could disrupt energy and trade flows. Diplomatic efforts remain crucial.
geoeconomicSummary: US-China trade tensions and global supply chain investments will shape trade balances. Resilience of Asian economies remains a key factor.
currentEventsSummary: Persistent inflation (3.46 CPI) pressures central bank action. Housing starts and industrial production show mixed momentum.
